title: The Ghost in the Model
subtitle: Round 3 — AI Chaos Room
summary: Famous AI artist 'PixelShade' was found dead in their smart studio. Their revolutionary AI model 'Genesis' was about to change the world. Who silenced them — and why? Follow the evidence. Trust the patterns.

suspects.name: Raghav Kapoor
suspects.bio: Controls all physical and digital access. Had motive to hide a secret backdoor built into Genesis.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was monitoring studio perimeter cameras.
suspects.motive: Was secretly planning to sell Genesis model weights to a competitor. Iraan threatened to report him.

suspects.name: Maya Shah
suspects.bio: Wants a quick launch. Under intense financial pressure from investors.
suspects.alibi: Working on marketing deck at home.
suspects.motive: Benefit if product succeeds rapidly without safety delays.

suspects.name: Devon Rossi
suspects.bio: Opposed safety delays. Had direct access to model weights.

suspects.name: Ishita Verma
suspects.bio: Quiet and observant. Had access to training data pipelines.

evidence.title: Final Diary Entry (Recovered)
evidence.content:
Someone in my team doesn't want Genesis to go public. They keep sabotaging the training runs. I checked the access logs. They have the keys, but not the vision. I'll expose them tomorrow. If I don't make it, the truth is in the final render layer. - P
(File: diary_last.txt)

evidence.title: Team Chat Snippet
evidence.content:
PixelShade: I pushed the new weights.
Devon: Should we really launch untested?
Maya: Investors don't care. Demo > Safety.
Raghav: If it flops, we all go down.
Devon: Not if someone takes the blame.
Maya: Chill. It's just an art tool.
PixelShade: It's more than a tool.
Raghav: Then stop acting like a saint.
